description: Every buy by one Solana copy-leader wallet that the desk observed in the last 14 days (newest 100): leader size, curve position, token age, other leaders on it, our quote drift and paper fill slip vs the leader, what the leader did next, the token's 60-minute path after the buy and the replayed copy return, plus a summary. On-chain addresses only. Rebuilt hourly; untracked wallets answer 404 and are not charged. Costs $0.01 USDC per call (x402).
